task:
Make the committed conformance suites test/supabase-member-plan.test.ts AND test/supabase-members-dryrun.test.ts pass. They are the SPEC and you CANNOT edit them (outside your write scope). Implement plan Section 4's PREVIEW layer. Edit ONLY under src/supabase/ and wrangler.jsonc.

1. src/supabase/member-plan.ts (new): a PURE planner.
   export interface CurrentMember { email: string; role: MemberRole } (import MemberRole from './member-schema').
   export type PlannedChangeKind = 'add' | 'update_role' | 'noop'.
   export interface PlannedChange { kind: PlannedChangeKind; targetEmail: string; fromRole: MemberRole | null; toRole: MemberRole; requestedProject: string | null; action: string }.
   export interface MembershipPlan { changes: PlannedChange[]; noops: PlannedChange[] }.
   export function planMembershipChange(current: CurrentMember[], assignments: MemberAssignment[]): MembershipPlan.
   Logic per assignment: match current member by email CASE-INSENSITIVELY. Not found -> kind 'add', fromRole null, toRole requestedRole, action 'supabase:members:invite'. Found and role === requestedRole -> kind 'noop' (goes in noops, not changes). Found and role differs -> kind 'update_role', fromRole = current role, toRole = requestedRole, action 'supabase:members:update_role'. add + update_role go in `changes`; noop goes in `noops`. Keep requestedProject from the assignment.

2. src/supabase/member-router.ts (edit): add a dry-run branch to the POST /:slug/invitations handler. When the query param dry_run === 'true':
   - keep steps 1-3 (bearer 401, COARSE authorize, parseMemberRequest 400).
   - resolve the PAT from the coarse AuthResult's upstreamTokenId via stub.resolveUpstreamTokenById (fall back to nothing -> 502 if missing, mirror managementApiHandler).
   - fetch CURRENT membership: GET https://api.supabase.com/v1/organizations/<slug>/members with the PAT as Bearer (reuse proxyToManagementApi(path, pat, 'GET') from ./proxy-helpers). Parse the JSON array; map each entry to { email, role } where role is the entry's role_name normalized to a canonical MemberRole (reuse a lenient normalizer - add and export normalizeRoleLenient(role: string): MemberRole | null to member-schema.ts if helpful; SKIP members whose role_name does not normalize).
   - plan = planMembershipChange(current, assignments).
   - authorize each change: for every change in plan.changes build a RequestContext { action: change.action, resource: `org:<slug>`, fields } (fields: supabase.requested_role = change.toRole, supabase.target_email, supabase.requested_project only when non-null, supabase.batch_size = String(plan.changes.length)); call stub.authorize(keyId, '', [ctx]); collect a human-readable string in `denied` when not authorized. Do NOT fail the request on denial.
   - return 200 JSON { dry_run: true, plan, denied } (new Response(JSON.stringify(...), { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } })). Breadcrumb 'supabase-members-invite-dry-run'. NO write, NO 501 in the dry-run path.
   The NON-dry-run path (dry_run !== 'true') keeps its existing behavior UNCHANGED (fine authorize -> rate limit -> 501).

WORKFLOW: read both conformance files and the existing member-router.ts first. Then implement. Run `bunx vitest run test/supabase-member-plan.test.ts test/supabase-members-dryrun.test.ts` as you go.

HARD CONSTRAINTS: Edit ONLY src/supabase/** and wrangler.jsonc. Do NOT weaken/skip/delete any test. Do NOT touch scripts/api-coverage. The dry-run path may fetch the List endpoint (GET, read-only) but must perform NO write and no 501. Keep the non-dry-run 501 behavior intact. Run prettier so `bun run lint` passes.
